guitar.evidence: Joe Satriani's Ibanez JS signature series is extremely well documented, one of the longest-running guitarist signature lines in the industry.

tone.target: bright liquid Satriani lead with singing sustain
tone.profile: bright liquid Satriani lead with singing sustain
tone.summary: A bright, liquid lead tone achieved using a mild boost, classic British amp voicing (UK 45), coupled with a clear cab, generous stereo delay for width, and subtle chorus/vibrato effects to enhance sustain and legato.
corrections: use even lead delay, not rhythmic dotted eighths

rig.name: Joe Satriani - Crystal Planet - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Provide controlled grit and sustain boost for lead lines (Tube Screamer emulation).

alternatives.reason: Similar mild overdrive, but 'Boost' is more direct for saturation lift.

blocks.purpose: Keep the tone clean and articulate; avoid heavy distortion.
Emulate the classic British lead tone (Marshall/Boogie style) with high clarity and brightness.

alternatives.reason: Slightly more aggressive, but UK 45 is better for liquid lead.

blocks.purpose: Provide a bright, articulate British cabinet sound that complements the UK 45 amp.
Slight mid-boost and overall tonal shaping to enhance note separation and brightness.
Add controlled width and liquid movement to the sustain without sounding like heavy chorus.

alternatives.reason: Too rhythmic; Chorus provides a more 'liquid' width.

blocks.purpose: Provide stereo width and sustain lift with even, non-rhythmic delay repeats.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle natural ambience and glue the tone together without muddying the lead lines.
